en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing large multi‑storey institutional brick buildings in a rural setting. The complex stands amid open fields with a few small outbuildings and trees in the foreground. The architecture is early 20th‑century, with simple rectangular blocks, pitched roofs, chimneys, and several balconies. Printed captions appear along the bottom edge of the image.
